newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures do not trade, interest low.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures do not trade, interest low.

text.p: Australian wheat futures did not trade on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Monday with the temporary absence of a major player from the market and with interest low ahead of the Chicago holiday.
Brendan Hillary of ANZ Futures Ltd said most bets were that the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) would leave its pool price unchanged in the revision scheduled for later on Monday.

The market was not being pushed one way or the other, with the next crop far away, with AWB still holding local prices at above the world market and with growers operating on a day-to-day basis on the prospect of lower prices ahead, he said.
